validation_findings: Synthetic finite physics models require stated units and truncations. Exact prime recovery uses the existing Arb engine; floating-point models do not inherit its certificate.

observations: Reviewed the sole GitHub workflow, pyproject.toml and requirements.txt inventory; commands cover full unittest suite and all eight default scientific examples. Independently reviewed physics bounds, wave composition and inverse-grid convergence. Fixed whole-interval model handling, generator reuse, sparse controls, exponent underflow and low-temperature cancellation.
validation_findings: The dedicated Python runtime closure includes the complete cache-free standard library, installed scientific dependencies excluding their unused tests/benchmarks/pip, package data, linked shared libraries and locale files: 3775 canonical files, 301390266 bytes. PYTHONHOME/PYTHONPATH select this runtime; PATH is empty and bytecode writes are disabled. Completeness is an authored review assertion. GitHub CI executes Python checks explicitly; local validation does not assert that hosted CI has run.

observations: Initial validation found 21 missing specification structure/density obligations and one 64 KiB config limit. Authored the required project sections and topology, preserved generated blocks, and reviewed a compact runtime contract. Both required commands remain: full unit suite and all eight application demos.
validation_findings: The compact runtime has 102 measured files including a standard-library ZIP, native Python/modules, system libraries and a complete scientific dependency archive. The immutable proof entry point extracts only regular files/directories inside owned scratch, disables ambient site processing and passes the extracted package path to child Python. Import diagnostic confirmed NumPy 2.3.5, SciPy 1.17.0, python-flint 0.9.0 and Matplotlib 3.10.8. This supersedes the earlier unpacked-runtime declaration.

observations: Decapod validation passed with 195 project gates, no failures, and two actual bounded native stages. Owned evidence /tmp/decapod-readiness-M00eHb reports 64 unit tests passed and all eight application demos passed. Generated eight JSON outputs, eight SVG figures and provenance from the checked application source; inspected the inverse-spectrum plot for legibility. Final artifact candidate still requires its own exact-commit validation.

Fixed standalone vendored-DSO lookup in the setup probe by using only trusted installed native directories.
